# $nproc identifies a job slot: jobs running at the same time never share
# one. a finishes first and c starts while b is still running, so c must
# reuse a's slot rather than share b's.
mk -q -p 2 -f mkfile
exec sh -c 'test "$(cat a.slot)" = "$(cat c.slot)" && test "$(cat b.slot)" != "$(cat c.slot)"'

-- mkfile --
all:V: a b c
a:V:
	echo $nproc > a.slot
	sleep 0.2
b:V:
	echo $nproc > b.slot
	sleep 1
c:V: a
	echo $nproc > c.slot
